description.zh: 部分返回参数语言。默认值：en。取值范围：en、zh、ja。
description.en: The language in which you want the values of some response parameters to be returned. These response parameters support multiple languages. Default value: en. Valid values: en, zh, and ja.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为**1**，默认为**1**。
description.en: The page number. Pages start from page **1**. Default value: **1**.
The number of entries to return per page. Default value: 200.

The type of the resource. Valid values:

*   **DOMAIN**: domain name

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-tags --lang en --resource-type DOMAIN --page-number 1 --page-size 200 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DescribeTags --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 200 --PageNumber 1 --Lang en --ResourceType DOMAIN
